comparison.objective: Ground each gripper, unpack circuit boards onto an ESD mat, and keep foam away; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: ESD task tests ordered grounding, delicate board transport, and contamination avoidance. Candidate tests precision tool insertion, counterholding, collar rotation, tightening, and dynamic diagnosis.
comparison.success_condition: Boards must reach the ESD mat after grounding without foam proximity; candidate requires two safe impact cycles and verified setting retention.
comparison.reason: The safety procedure and manipulation outcome are materially different; the record omits detailed scoring thresholds but clearly identifies its tested ability.
